purpose: Qualify or reject PBE/SSSP-v2 as the first low-cost H/Ru(0001) electronic-structure candidate using only pseudopotential provenance, Ru bulk numerical convergence, and Ru bulk structural fidelity. No kinetic, barrier, diffusion-rate, published adsorption-site energy, chi, or expected ChemSA outcome may influence selection.

full_method_selection_still_requires: H top/bridge/fcc/hcp site screen without imposing the published minimum
local H vibrational-mode stability for the numerically selected adsorption minimum

bulk_reference.role: non-kinetic room-temperature structural comparator and center of a symmetric predeclared grid; not a kinetic fit target
bulk_reference.source: WebElements Ru crystal structure table, citing V. A. Finkel, M. I. Palatnik, and G. P. Kovtun, Phys. Met. Metall. 32, 231 (1971)

frozen_electronic_settings.spin_polarization: none for bulk Ru candidate screen

cutoff_grid.selection_rule: Choose the lowest pair whose absolute total-energy difference per atom from the highest 80/320 Ry reference is <= 0.001 eV/atom.

kmesh_selection_rule: At the selected cutoff pair, choose the lowest mesh whose absolute total-energy difference per atom from 24x24x16 is <= 0.001 eV/atom.

structure_grid.rule: Evaluate the full 5x5 Cartesian product of a and c scale factors around the external structural comparator using selected numerical settings. Fit a two-dimensional quadratic energy surface. The stationary point must lie inside the frozen grid and have a positive-definite Hessian.

structural_gate.reason: A deliberately simple one-percent structural screen is frozen prospectively as a method-candidate gate; it is not retuned to the PBE result.

execution.reason_native_restart_not_required: Each bulk SCF is an independent two-atom calculation with its own bounded 1200-second timeout; partial completed cases are retained if a later case fails.
